arms.name: rlm-full
arms.note: Three runs on the fan-out rig: one sub-task call carries up to 12 ids and the host runs the batches of 4 on three threads. Same query and arm as m11-rigv5-cell, so the wall-clock means are comparable and the cost should not move.

queries.text: Across the retrieved papers, what methods do recursive language model systems use to aggregate information that exceeds a single context window, and how do they differ in where the aggregation happens?
queries.note: Same query as m11-rigv5-cell and the m11-check series.
